reads.AORT: mixed — a still-compounding EBITDA/growth franchise against a fresh guidance cut, an On-X recall, elevated leverage and negative FCF.
reads.BRBR: mixed — intact volume/category demand offsets a structural margin reset, deep estimate cuts, and elevated leverage.
reads.CNXC: mixed — a self-funding, guidance-meeting, near-floor-multiple business against a goodwill-impaired, 4.1x-levered, hard-de-rating consensus with an earned peer discount.
reads.EPAM: mixed — a genuinely idiosyncratic -72pp de-rate and self-funding net-cash balance sheet sit against real margin erosion, cut estimates and management-flagged second-half visibility loss.
reads.FUBO: strongly-bearish — idiosyncratic -83% relative collapse, across-the-board FY26 estimate cuts crossing zero, and unfunded cash burn with opaque leverage.
reads.IT: mixed — a durable high-retention cash franchise trading at its own-history floor, but with a genuinely stalled top line and partly earned peer discount.
reads.MVST: strongly-bearish — stated going-concern doubt with a near-term maturity wall against thin cash while adjusted EBITDA has turned negative and revenue is contracting.
reads.NCNO: mixed — positive-and-rising absolute EBITDA and a below-peer forward multiple lean bullish, but decelerating growth and an unexplained gap-down keep the overshoot-vs-earned question open.
reads.SMPL: mixed — a self-funding, category-leading credit with a genuinely shrinking top line and unresolved share loss on both sides.
reads.VITL: mixed — a clean balance sheet and reversible price-gap mechanics offset an ~97% FY26 EBITDA collapse, cash burn, and weakening trial.
reads.VRRM: mixed — a large, verified, structural Avis revenue loss offsets a genuinely cash-generative, self-funding, high-margin business trading at a floor multiple.
